record.question: A patient on lithium therapy is scheduled for ECT. The nurse anticipates:
options: Lithium levels may need to be held or reduced
Lithium is required to enhance seizure duration
Continue lithium to prevent mania during treatment
record.explanation: Answer B: Lithium levels may need to be held or reduced. Lithium can increase risks of prolonged seizures, delirium, or neurotoxicity with ECT; clinicians may hold or reduce it and monitor levels based on individual risk. Source/context note: Medication decisions must be individualized by the treating psychiatrist/anesthesiologist. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK538266/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
